profile.name: İbrahim Özkan
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.tagline: M.Sc. student at HPI Potsdam building React/TypeScript, Flutter, and applied-AI systems across SAP Signavio, digital health research, and startup products.
profile.summary: M.Sc. student at HPI Potsdam with 4+ years building software across SAP Signavio, digital health research, startup products, and mobile ERP pilots. Strong in React/TypeScript micro-frontends, Flutter, backend APIs, testing, and applied AI systems. Co-founded Gatsot: €30K pre-seed, 5,500+ users, and 18,000+ processed receipts.
profile.availability: Open to working student, junior, and graduate roles in Berlin, Potsdam, Cyprus, or remote within Germany/EU.

experience.title: SAP iXp Intern, Process Value Analysis
bullets: Worked on a React/TypeScript micro-frontend for SAP Signavio's process-analysis product area (GraphQL/Apollo, Module Federation v2) and shipped Export Value Cases to production with Vitest and Cypress coverage in CI.

Debugged release-blocking integration issues that did not reproduce in the isolated development app, requiring investigation inside the integrated shell host that runs multiple remote micro-frontends before the May release.

Identified a gap in local integration testing and built a zero-dependency Node.js workflow that runs local micro-frontend code inside the integrated shell host, helping reproduce bugs hidden by local-only setups.

Coordinated fixes across engineering and design stakeholders: triaged Jira reports, consulted with other micro-frontend teams, aligned UI/UX details with designers, and helped choose implementation paths for production fixes.

Built an AI agent setup management marketplace and PR-based sync workflow (GitHub Actions, GitHub App installation-token auth, Node.js) to propagate shared skills, MCP server configs, hooks, and workflows across team repositories through reviewable update PRs.

experience.company: Hasso Plattner Institute, Digital Health Center
experience.title: Student Research Assistant
bullets: Built and shipped features for StudyU, an open-source digital health platform (Flutter, Supabase) used in N-of-1 clinical trials in personalized medicine research.
Built and shipped StudyU AI, a full-stack AI assistant for study design (FastAPI, PydanticAI, React) with fault-tolerant LLM execution and structured output validation.
Designed a multi-agent pipeline with a custom MCP tool that grounds agents on PubMed evidence and extracts structured clinical trial components.
Engineered Fitbit sensor-data integration and statistical reporting for N-of-1 trial result visualizations.

experience.title: Co-Founder & CTO
bullets: Co-founded Gatsot (gatsot.app), a price-comparison platform with 5,500+ organic users, 18,000+ processed receipts, and current growth of ~1,500 receipts and ~500 new users/month.
Raised €30,000 pre-seed funding through the YAGA entrepreneurship grant and joined the Startups4Peace 2025 accelerator.
Built the receipt-processing pipeline (Laravel, cloud OCR, LLMs) with validation for varied Turkish receipt formats and downstream product-price matching.
Ran B2B product discovery with wholesale managers to shape a market-insight analytics dashboard roadmap.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built a pilot offline-first Flutter mobile ERP for Odoo workflows across warehouse, sales, invoicing, and payments.
Implemented SQLite offline sync with periodic reconciliation and conflict handling for field work during network outages.
Integrated barcode scanning and thermal printing to reduce manual entry in warehouse and sales workflows.

experience.title: Internship
bullets: Delivered an admin and company management panel for the Kimden service marketplace (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap), covering project management, application review, and live analytics.
Built a Flutter mobile app with Google Maps, geolocation, multi-parameter filtering, and REST API integrations for construction-project discovery in Northern Cyprus.
